title: AuditEntry — Foundry Actions Framework
description: Schema for the AuditEntry ontology object that every ActionType writes. Immutable once written; supersession via a new AuditEntry referencing the prior action_id, never edit-in-place.

action_id.description: Globally unique UUID. Generated at side_effect execution.

actor_role.description: RBAC role of the actor AT EXECUTION TIME. Snapshot at execution; later role changes do not retroactively alter the audit entry.

approver.description: user_id of the dual-approval approver. Null when dual_approval_required is false.

approver_role.description: RBAC role of the approver at execution time.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone. Server-generated; not user-supplied.

target_object_id.description: Identifier of the ontology object affected (e.g. Counterparty.counterparty_id).

prior_state.description: Snapshot of the fields the action modified, BEFORE the update. Schema varies by ActionType.

new_state.description: Snapshot of the same fields, AFTER the update.

justification.description: Analyst-supplied justification text. min_length 200 chars enforced at Action submission per SR 11-7 §V documentation-specificity expectation.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: IDs of supporting-evidence ontology objects (AdverseMediaMention, SanctionsHit, etc.) referenced by the action.

supporting_evidence_snapshot_uri.description: URI to an immutable snapshot of the evidence objects AS THEY EXISTED AT EXECUTION TIME. Critical for examiner-readiness: evidence content can drift; the snapshot preserves what the analyst actually relied on.

immutable.description: Always true. Supersession via a new AuditEntry referencing the prior action_id; never edit-in-place.

superseded_by.description: If this AuditEntry has been superseded, the action_id of the superseding entry. Null otherwise. Supersession is rare — used for corrections like wrong target_object_id.

retention_policy.description: Retention bucket identifier. Default 'regulatory_7_year_minimum' — institution may extend per its own policy but never reduce below regulatory floor.
